name: Claretcup
desc: Claretcup (Echinocereus triglochidiatus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 173 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinocereus triglochidiatus is a species of hedgehog cactus known by several common names, including kingcup cactus, claret cup cactus, red-flowered hedgehog cactus and Mojave mound cactus.
